expected_behavior.description: Jump to a point within range, covering a distance based on your STR score. Costs a bonus action and movement equal to the distance jumped.

notes: Point-targeted bonus action that teleports the caster to a location within jump distance. Jump distance = STR score in feet / 2 (roughly). Costs bonus action + movement. WARNING: Teleport functor is a known stub in FunctorExecutor — this action may not fully execute. Verify teleport resolves or mark as blocked.
